STILLROOT'S SONG   |   PLAYER HANDOUT

Stillroot's Song

Can you trust your memory?

Welcome to Stillroot Hollow, a fog-wrapped village buried deep in forgotten woods. The locals are polite. The streets are quiet. There is a warm room waiting for travellers who have been on the road too long. Nothing ever seems wrong... except the feeling that something is.

This is a level-10 D&D one-shot for 4-6 players, lasting about 4-6 hours. Expect an unsettling mystery, character-driven tension, difficult choices and moments of danger. Investigation and cooperation matter as much as powerful abilities. The horror builds slowly; the things you notice may matter later.

Your characters are an established adventuring company arriving wounded and exhausted after a hard victory. You are looking for refuge and help for a fallen friend. Bring someone who can care about another person, ask a question when an answer feels wrong, and stand beside companions when courage becomes difficult.

The game uses agreed horror boundaries. You can ask to pause, veil a description or redirect a scene. The characters may be frightened; the players should remain welcome and able to participate.
